purpose: Learn mathematical continued pretraining with 5B distinct sampled tokens and two epochs
initialization: fresh pinned Coder base; use the same complete 10B schedule after any restart
precision: BF16 autocast compute; FP32 parameters, gradients and AdamW moments
source: OpenWebMath only; exact selected text/URL deduplication, not near-deduplication
validation_policy: Retain the pilot validation token prefix; exclude all pilot validation text hashes and URLs from training; keep split decisions independent of token budgets
shuffle: Independent deterministic block permutation for each epoch

timing.note: Re-estimate from long-run measured throughput and actual evaluation/save overhead; complete the fixed 10B budget

limitations: Fast backend has recorded compiler rounding differences and did not pass strict per-probe native-gradient equivalence
No GSM8K/MATH benchmark decontamination has been performed; no paper metric reproduction claim
Corpus size is measured using the pinned Qwen tokenizer, not the paper tokenizer
